entries.title: John 14:1
segments: "Let not your hearts be troubled. You trust in God, trust in me also.

entries.title: John 14:2
segments: In my Father's house there are many rooms If it were not so, would I have told you that I went to prepare a place for you?

entries.title: John 14:3
segments: I will return and will take you to be with me, so that where I am you may be also.

entries.title: John 14:4
segments: And the way is known to you all, where I am going."

entries.title: John 14:5
segments: "We do not know where you are going Lord," said Thomas, "so how can we know the way?"

entries.title: John 14:6
segments: Jesus answered him: "I am the Way, the Truth and the Life. No man ever comes to the Father but by me.

entries.title: John 14:7
segments: If you had known me, you would have known my Father too; from now on you know him and have seen him."

entries.title: John 14:8
segments: "Lord," said Philip, "cause us to see the Father, and we shall be satisfied."

entries.title: John 14:9
segments: "Have I been so long among you, and yet you, Philip, have you not recognized me? He who has seen me has seen the Father. How can you say, `Cause us to see the Father'?

entries.title: John 14:10
segments: "Do you not believe that I am in the Father and the Father in me? The words that I speak to you I speak not of myself; but the Father, who ever dwells in me, is doing his own work.

entries.title: John 14:11
segments: "Believe me, all of you, that I am in the Father and the Father in me, or else believe me for the very words' sake.

entries.title: John 14:12
segments: "I tell you solemnly that he who trusts in me shall himself do the works that I am doing; and still greater works than these, because I am going to my Father.

entries.title: John 14:13
segments: "And whatever' you ask in my name I will do; that the Father may be glorified in the Son.

entries.title: John 14:14
segments: "If you ask anything in my name, I will do it.

entries.title: John 14:15
segments: "If you love me, you will obey my commandments,

entries.title: John 14:16
segments: "and I will pray the Father,

entries.title: John 14:17
segments: "and he will give you another Comforter to be with you forever, the Spirit of Truth. The world cannot receive him because it does not see him nor know him, but you know him, for he is ever with you and within you.

entries.title: John 14:18
segments: "I will not leave you comfortless; I will come to you.

entries.title: John 14:19
segments: "Yet a little while and the world shall see me no more, but you shall see me; because I live, you, too, shall live.

entries.title: John 14:20
segments: "At that day you shall understand that I am in my Father, and you in me, and I in you.

entries.title: John 14:21
segments: "It is he who has my commands and obeys them that loves me; and he who loves me shall be loved by my Father, and I will love him and will manifest myself to him."

entries.title: John 14:22
segments: "How is it, Lord," said Judas (not Iscariot) "that you will manifest yourself to us and not to the world?"

entries.title: John 14:23
segments: Jesus replied : "If any loves me he will obey my word, and my Father will love him, and we will come to him and make our home with him.

entries.title: John 14:24
segments: "He that loves me not does not obey words, and yet the words to which you are listening are not mine, but the Father's who sent me.

entries.title: John 14:25
segments: "All this I told you while still with you.

entries.title: John 14:26
segments: "But the Comforter, the Holy Spirit, whom the Father will send in my name, will teach you everything, and bring to your remembrance everything that I have told you.

entries.title: John 14:27
segments: "Peace I leave with you. My own peace I give to you. It is not the world's `Peace' I give you. Let not your heart be troubled, neither let it be afraid.

entries.title: John 14:28
segments: "You heard me tell you, `I am going away, and yet I am coming to you.' If you loved me you would have been glad because I said `I am going to the Father,' for my Father is greater than I.

entries.title: John 14:29
segments: "And now I tell you this before it happens, so that when it does happen you may believe.

entries.title: John 14:30
segments: "I shall not talk with you much more, for the Prince of this world is coming.

entries.title: John 14:31
segments: "He has nothing in me, but in his coming the world may know that I love the Father, and that I do just as the Father commanded. Rise, let us be going!"
